script_hooks.logic:
Let resultObjectsInFrame be the results v4 this frame.
Set resultObjectsInFrame to resultObjectsInFrame → concat with (the results v5 this frame).
If the register's 'hasMatchedAnswer' and (set resultObjectsInFrame to the items x in resultObjectsInFrame where not not x's 'ability', then the length of resultObjectsInFrame is not 0), then
  Let v6 be the value "abilityId" of resultObjectsInFrame at 0's 'ability'.
  If not (the register's 'currMimeAbilityTag' and v6 is the id of the move labelled the register's 'currMimeAbilityTag' on the enemy or resultObjectsInFrame at 0's 'executer' → is-enemy), then
    Let v7 be the value "reasonStatusAilmentId" of resultObjectsInFrame at 0's 'ability'.
    Let v8 be the value "abilityCategoryId" of resultObjectsInFrame at 0's 'ability'.
    Let v9 be _ → flatten with ([game:StatusAilmentsConfig.regenIds, the SAP status]).
    If not (v9 contains v7 and not v8), then
      Set the register's 'hasMatchedAnswer' to not the register's 'hasAnsweredAlready' and _ → index-of with (the register's 'answerAbilityIds', v6) is at least 0.
      Set the register's 'hasAnsweredAlready' to true.
